message.content: In the discussion about the ending of Red Dead Redemption 2, Aisling expresses a deeply emotional reaction. She describes feeling "heartbroken" when Arthur realizes his fate and tries to make things right with John and his family. This emotional moment is further emphasized by the music playing during the final ride, which Aisling notes was "just perfect." This final scene leaves a lasting impression on her, highlighting the impact of the game's narrative and musical score.
